lines.beaver: 어제 민수랑 지은이 만났잖아. 민수가 뭐래?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu and Jieun met yesterday. What did Minsu say?
lines.beaver_roman: Eoje minsurang jieuni mannatjana. Minsuga mworae?
lines.en: He said Jieun was really beautiful. His first impression was good.

lines.beaver_en: Really? What did he say her hair looked like?
lines.en: Long straight hair. He said her bangs were neatly combed.

lines.beaver: 어? 지은이 머리 짧지 않았어? 신기하다.
lines.beaver_en: Huh? Wasn't Jieun's hair short? That's surprising.
lines.beaver_roman: Eo? Jieuni meori jjalji anasseo? Singihada.
lines.learner: 원래 단발머리였는데 길렀대. 파마도 안 했대.
lines.en: She used to have a bob, but she grew it out. No perm either.
lines.roman: Wollae danbalmeoriyeonneunde gilleotdae. Pamado an haetdae.

lines.beaver_en: What about her outfit? Jieun dresses well.
lines.learner: 옷이 정말 세련됐대. 금 목걸이도 했대.
lines.en: He said her clothes were really stylish. She wore a gold necklace too.
lines.roman: Osi jeongmal seryeondwaetdae. Geum mokgeorido haetdae.

lines.beaver_en: Of course! How was her expression? Was she nervous?
lines.en: She was nervous at first. But her expression was bright.

lines.beaver_en: What a relief. She's looked really tired lately.
lines.en: Her complexion was good too. Her skin was very lovely.

lines.beaver_en: Didn't he say anything about her scent?
lines.learner: 아, 맞다. 꽃 향수를 뿌렸대. 냄새가 좋았대.
lines.en: Oh, right. She wore floral perfume. It smelled nice.
lines.roman: A, matda. Kkot hyangsureul ppuryeotdae. Naemsaega joatdae.

lines.beaver: 외모랑 첫인상 얘기 더 해 줄래?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about her looks and first impression?
lines.beaver_roman: Oemorang cheosinsang yaegi deo hae jullae?
lines.en: Her face was round and cute. She smiled a lot.

lines.beaver: 와, 민수가 지은이를 많이 좋아하나 봐.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, Minsu must really like Jieun.
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, minsuga jieunireul mani joahana bwa.
lines.learner: 응. 다음 주에 또 만난대. 영화 본대.
lines.en: Yeah. They're meeting again next week. They'll see a movie.
lines.roman: Eung. Daeum jue tto mannandae. Yeonghwa bondae.

lines.en: Okay. Let's cheer for things to go well for them!
